name: Wakakusa Nanoha
source:
[url=/c4558]Kou[/url]'s childhood friend who is a year younger than him. Kind, sensitive and talented at gardening and cooking, she often bursts into tears at the slightest provocation.
[spoiler]Her parents were researchers at the Drexler Organisation and mentors to [url=/c20522]Kurihara Naoki[/url] until they were killed in a terrorist attack. After the events of Grey Christmas, she becomes the keeper of an internet cafe Kou and Rain unwittingly frequent.[/spoiler]
